segments.sn4.8:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.sn4.8:1.3: Atha kho māro pāpimā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi –
segments.sn4.8:2.1: “Nandati puttehi puttimā, gomā gobhi tatheva nandati;
segments.sn4.8:2.3: Upadhīhi narassa nandanā, na hi so nandati yo nirūpadhī”ti.
segments.sn4.8:3.1: “Socati puttehi puttimā, gomā gobhi tatheva socati;
segments.sn4.8:3.3: Upadhīhi narassa socanā, na hi so socati yo nirūpadhī”ti.
segments.sn4.8:4.1: Atha kho māro pāpimā “jānāti maṃ bhagavā, jānāti maṃ sugato”ti dukkhī dummano tatthevantaradhāyīti.
